name: web-starter-v2
description: A blank template to get started with Payload 3.0

scripts.build: cross-env CLOUDFLARE_ENV=dev PAYLOAD_MIGRATE_REMOTE=false PAYLOAD_SECRET=local-build-placeholder NODE_OPTIONS="--no-deprecation --max-old-space-size=8000" next build --webpack
scripts.deploy: pnpm run deploy:database && pnpm run deploy:app
scripts.deploy:app: cross-env PAYLOAD_MIGRATE_REMOTE=true pnpm run guard:cloudflare-env && opennextjs-cloudflare build --env=$CLOUDFLARE_ENV && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --env=$CLOUDFLARE_ENV
scripts.deploy:database: cross-env NODE_ENV=production PAYLOAD_MIGRATE_REMOTE=true pnpm run guard:cloudflare-env && cross-env NODE_ENV=production PAYLOAD_MIGRATE_REMOTE=true PAYLOAD_SECRET=ignore payload migrate && wrangler d1 execute D1 --command 'PRAGMA optimize' --env=$CLOUDFLARE_ENV --remote
scripts.dev: cross-env CLOUDFLARE_ENV=dev PAYLOAD_MIGRATE_REMOTE=false NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation next dev
scripts.devsafe: rm -rf .next && rm -rf .open-next && cross-env CLOUDFLARE_ENV=dev PAYLOAD_MIGRATE_REMOTE=false NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation next dev
scripts.generate:types: pnpm run generate:types:cloudflare && pnpm run generate:types:payload
scripts.payload: pnpm run guard:cloudflare-env && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation payload
scripts.preview: cross-env CLOUDFLARE_ENV=dev PAYLOAD_MIGRATE_REMOTE=false PAYLOAD_SECRET=local-preview-placeholder pnpm run guard:cloudflare-env && cross-env CLOUDFLARE_ENV=dev PAYLOAD_MIGRATE_REMOTE=false PAYLOAD_SECRET=local-preview-placeholder opennextjs-cloudflare build --env=dev && cross-env CLOUDFLARE_ENV=dev PAYLOAD_MIGRATE_REMOTE=false PAYLOAD_SECRET=local-preview-placeholder opennextjs-cloudflare preview --env=dev
scripts.test: pnpm run test:int && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: cross-env CLOUDFLARE_ENV=dev PAYLOAD_MIGRATE_REMOTE=false PAYLOAD_SECRET=local-test-placeholder BEMOAT_TEST_WRANGLER_PERSIST=.wrangler-test/e2e NODE_OPTIONS="--no-deprecation --import=tsx/esm" playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:int: cross-env NODE_ENV=test CLOUDFLARE_ENV=dev PAYLOAD_MIGRATE_REMOTE=false PAYLOAD_SECRET=local-test-placeholder BEMOAT_TEST_WRANGLER_PERSIST=.wrangler-test/state/v3 NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation vitest run --environment node --config ./vitest.config.mts
scripts.check: pnpm run guard:cloudflare-env && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:int

PAYLOAD_SECRET.description: Generate a random string using `openssl rand -hex 32`
